member.name: T:ServiceCore.CSharp.EngineHelpers
member.summary: Helper methods for pure implementation of .

member.name: M:ServiceCore.CSharp.EngineHelpers.InitializeSync(ServiceCore.InitializationContext,ServiceCore.IInitializationArgs)
member.summary: Initializes while blocking main/calling thread. Not provided in Unity because it might deadlock more easily there.
member.remarks: In WPF (or just plain C#) it's recommended to use this method directly in Program.Main(args) method as to avoid deadlocks. (e.g. before SynchronizationContext activates) But you are free to call it whenever if you 100% sure there will be no problems with deadlocks and synchronization.

member.name: M:ServiceCore.CSharp.EngineHelpers.TerminateSync(ServiceCore.ITerminationArgs)
member.summary: Terminates while blocking main/calling thread. Not provided in Unity because it might deadlock more easily there.
member.remarks: In WPF (or just plain C#), be cautious about when you use this method, as to avoid deadlocks. No piece of advice here - just good luck in finding a good place for this method call.
